completion_gate: Canonical generator run is completed_valid from a clean Git revision.
Independent verifier run exactly reproduces integer metrics and validates witnesses.
Coordinator records a scoped decision and next experiment.
constraints: No production keys, deployed targets, or special weak curves.
No protocol edits after approval without a versioned amendment.
No faster-than-rho or deployment claim from toy evidence.
handoff.objective: Execute the frozen three-size coordinate-energy preflight and return independently verified artifacts.
handoff.return_format: AGENTS.md handoff plus immutable run and evidence records
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether any tested coordinate-defined factor base departs enough from a random set to justify a larger compiled-decomposition study.
